[E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
+-- CanvasHistoryService: owns history and its storage boundary
|   +-- openContext(document, view, record?) -> runtime handle
|   +-- state / document / resolve: read boundary
|   +-- append / navigate / reset: history commands
|   `-- export / persistenceChanges / fork / adopt / retireTransactions
+-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService: private contexts WeakMap
|   +-- openContext -> new CanvasHistory; freeze handle; retain history
|   +-- handle identity isolates viewers of one persisted context
|   +-- unreachable handles allow history collection
|   `-- runtime service and handles stay out of saved canvases
+-- Controller -> service -> retained CanvasHistory
|   +-- append(document, view, correspondence) -> history.append
|   +-- state -> head.id / document / view / canUndo / canRedo
|   +-- resolve(diagramId) -> history.diagrams.resolve(contextId, id)
|   +-- navigate -> reject linked transfer; otherwise history.navigate
|   `-- export/fork/adopt/reset/deltas delegate behind boundary
+-- Coordinated transfer API
|   +-- prepareTransfer -> prepareCanvasTransfer(exported histories, input)
|   +-- transferBoundary needs current headId + transaction + canvasId
|   `-- prepareTransferNavigation exports both participant histories
+-- MappingPage: owns workspace transfer coordination
|   +-- beginTransfer retains selection + source checkpoint ID
|   +-- transfer checks captured checkpoint; pauses incremental persistence
|   +-- runWorkspaceTask(transfer): exported histories + input/views
|   |   `-- prepared source/destination states + transaction
|   +-- publishTransfer -> await storage.save -> installWorkspace
|   |   `-- installs sessions, transfers, active ID, fresh view state
|   +-- undo/redo: boundary? -> prepareTransferNavigation
|   |   +-- require both canvases; undo newer dependent transfers first
|   |   `-- persist both histories + transaction before installation
|   `-- deleting canvas retires participant links in surviving histories
+-- CanvasWorkspace / CanvasSession: session lifetime + publication
|   +-- session retains baseline keys and controller subscription
|   +-- checkpoint ID change -> session.onCommit -> workspace.onPersist
|   +-- copyDocument: cloned view + controller.forkHistory(view)
|   |   +-- clears selection/controls; copied conversations stop pending
|   |   `-- creates new draft/session; source session remains registered
|   `-- replacement/removal disposes old session subscriptions
+-- WorkspacePersistence: owns live-owner -> record translation
|   +-- retains per-session delta cursor in WeakMap
|   +-- retains known drafts, index state, subscriptions, paused flag
|   +-- sync: controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> historyChanges
|   |   +-- metadata / baseline / revision / checkpoint records
|   |   +-- new session: remove obsolete history records in same batch
|   |   `-- existing immutable revisions reused; retired links may change
|   +-- canvas/viewport records sample SourcePaneViewState
|   +-- index: projectId / document IDs / active ID / transfers
|   `-- removed draft -> delete prefixed records; dispose -> unsubscribe
+-- RecordStorage: owns cache, pending map, one in-flight batch
|   +-- pending map retains latest change per key; timer schedules pump
|   +-- pump -> transport.write(requestId, expectedRevision, changes)
|   +-- acknowledgement advances revision/persisted sequence
|   +-- ambiguous failure retains same batch and request ID for retry
|   +-- commit -> flush old work -> batch -> flush acknowledgement
|   |   `-- definitive REJECTED -> restore cache; discard abandoned batch
|   `-- caller flushes before close; dispose clears timer/listeners
`-- WorkspaceStorage: owns one worker + pending request promises
    +-- load -> worker state -> RecordStorage(write transport)
    +-- save(snapshot) -> load/flush -> project -> records.commit
    +-- request IDs correlate worker replies with waiting promises
    +-- restore -> flush/dispose records -> reload
    `-- dispose -> dispose records; terminate worker; reject requests
